title: Trustpilot appeals: what 890 reversals actually measure
geographic_scope: EU businesses reviewed by EU users; EU businesses reviewed by non-EU users; non-EU businesses reviewed by EU users. This is the scope stated on the report cover page.
notes: Decisions omitted is retained separately: the published complaint total already equals upheld plus partially reversed plus reversed. The supplied CSV does not explain how the omitted metric overlaps that total.
Median-time values are not analysed because the supplied file does not specify their unit.
Reporting dates follow the identification CSV and cover page; one qualitative passage instead says 18 February.
The unallocated residual is our subtraction, not an official reason category.

rows.source_indicator: Complaint regarding a decision to suspend or terminate the provision of the service

rows.source_indicator: Complaint regarding a decision to suspend or terminate an account
